message: リアせんぱいといっしょ

name: Synn
message: 「I'm pretty sure it was around here...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't the Demon King just got no sense of direction?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true! Watch how you phrase that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sheesh... Getting lost, of all things.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're going to complain, you shouldn't have followed me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you talking about!! Wherever Ria-chan is, there I am! A knight's gotta do what a knight's gotta do」

name: Synn
message: 「Where did the Great Sage go?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where are *you* even headed, Demon King?」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, well, that's--」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, you two. Welcooome.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's up? It's rare for you to go out of your way to pick us, Sis.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm. I'd say it's less from me and more of a request from the client. When I heard what it was, I figured you two would be the right fit.」

name: Synn
message: 「A request? So this job isn't from you, Ms. Helena?」

name: Helena
message: 「Remember how hard you all worked at Kirafes?」

name: Helena
message: 「One of the clients from back then said they'd like a little help.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's something we can do, we'd be glad to help!」

name: Helena
message: 「I knew you'd say that♪」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what's the actual job? You said we're the right fit--」

name: Helena
message: 「They asked for a guy-and-girl pair. And your destination is... a kindergarten!」

name: Synn
message: 「A demon... blood, abyss?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You've been playing way too many games, Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, so we'll be helping out the preschool teachers.」

name: Ria
message: 「Apparently a teacher suddenly fell ill, so they're in a real bind」

name: Synn
message: 「This is an important mission... When it comes to taking care of kids, all I really know how to do is endure getting punched and kicked」

name: Ria
message: 「Boys always get stuck with that kind of role, don't they\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Since they're counting on us, I have to do a solid job... Still, without any real know-how, what am I even supposed to do」

name: Ria
message: 「Heheheh」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「If that's the case, just leave it to your big sister Ria!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm gonna show you just how amazing your senpai really is, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a huge help」

name: Paqy
message: 「And just like that, our pathetic Student Council President is getting carried the whole way. Without Ria-chan, he couldn't even make it to the destination」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shut up!」
Still, if Ria-senpai is coming along with that much confidence, I have nothing to worry about.
Alright, I've gotta do my best too.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, there it is! That kindergarten right over there」

name: Ria
message: 「Hiii, everyone~. Let's all hold hands with Big Sis Ria~~♪」
There stood Ria-senpai, forming a circle with the little kids and calling out in a bright, energetic voice.
The kids didn't look like they were dealing with a stranger at all, either--they were playfully roughhousing with her, having a blast.
Right at the center of it all was undeniably the Ria-senpai I knew, blending in so naturally you'd never guess it was her first time here.

name: Ria
message: 「Is everyone here~? Alright then, let's sing a song together!」
Ah, I've seen this scene somewhere before.
She's the exact image of a singing big sister from an educational kids' show.
Her whole vibe and presence are completely spot-on, and yet.
Why is even Ria-senpai wearing a kindergarten uniform?

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah, she's way too cute, Ria-chan... *thud*」
Did he pass out from sheer sublimity?
Given Senpai's mature figure, the contrast is staggering.
Ria-senpai looked totally confident and the kids have already taken a shine to her, so it's probably fine, though...
Just looking at her gives me the illusion that I'm doing something wrong.
I've said it over and over, there's no problem. Rather, it's starting to feel like I'm the one with the problem.

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry about that. I got lost...」
Feeling somehow embarrassed, I can't look directly at Ria-senpai.

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone~ Synn-oniisan is here, so let's say hello, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hello~」
Prompted by Ria-senpai's bright smile and "Hello~," everyone welcomes me.

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, Synn-kun. Right away, go get changed. Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! You're telling me to wear that outfit?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course♪ This is the best thing to wear when playing with everyone at the kindergarten, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I mean, it might be good for playing, sure, but that outfit is a bit much...」

name: Ria
message: 「What are you saying! This is a proper uniform, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... that you just took Helena-san's word for that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-Th-Th-That's n-n-n-not true! I properly checked it myself--」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you think Helena-san is totally capable of doing something like that? Teasing you like this, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-What should I do, Synn-kun! I-I didn't even realize that...」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu~~. I mean, I did think it was weird at first. But the kids didn't seem to think anything strange of it...」

name: Synn
message: 「I―I'm sorry! If I hadn't said anything unnecessary―」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, it's not your fault! If you hadn't told me, Synn-kun, I wouldn't have noticed until the very end...」
The children gaze worriedly at a panicking Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, nobody's troubled by it, so isn't it fine to leave it as is?」

name: Ria
message: 「But, but!」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, I'll dress up like that with you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh」

name: Synn
message: 「If we do it together, there's nothing to be embarrassed about!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」
I was a little embarrassed at first, but the kids didn't care one bit.
The two of us mixed in with the kindergarteners, running around and making a lively racket.
It felt like I'd gone back to being a kid, so my initial anxiety and the awkwardness of the outfit faded away, and I was able to have fun right up until the end.
I guess it was because I got to be with Ria-senpai, after all.
And then, after our volunteering at the kindergarten was over--

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「You know how hard it was? Making a kindergarten uniform that could fit that plump, curvy body of yours. Though I'm sure it was still tight on you\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「And mine wasn't any trouble at all, huh... Boohoo.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! Today of all days, I'm never gonna forgive you!」

name: Helena
message: 「Heheh. Time to make a quick getaway!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Those two sure are close.」

name: Helena
message: 「So, Synn-chan. How did Ria look in the kindergarten uniform?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?! You already shook her off?!」

name: Helena
message: 「The one Ria chased after was Melilot dressed up like me.」
I wonder if Helena-san has some kind of dirt on Melilot-san.

name: Helena
message: 「A-ny-way! How was it? Did you get excited? All hot and bothered? Turned on?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What are you saying?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, you're all flustered~☆ Your reaction gives it to-tal-ly a-way\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, s-seeing someone Senpai's age dressed like that, uh, well...」

name: Helena
message: 「I see~~ So the gap from the age difference really is the deciding factor, huh.」
D-Don't tell me Helena-san is going to say she'll wear one herself next...

name: Helena
message: 「That means if we make Melilot, whose age is a complete mystery, wear it, the destructive power will be even more off the charts!♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh」

name: Helena
message: 「Alright! It's decided! Next time, we're putting Melilot in one!」
How should I put it--going out of her way to procure custom-made kindergarten uniforms just for this makes Helena-san pretty amazing in my book.
In a lot of ways.
